issues.where: ring arch at left limb (tile B) and right arch (tiles C, F, H)
issues.what: on the left (tile B), the inner ring arcs cut off abruptly in mid-air above the atmospheric limb glow; across the right arch (tiles C, F, H), the bright outer and main rings have 1-px stair-step aliasing and stark pure-white clipping instead of the smooth anti-aliased curves and subtle warm chromatic edge tint in -a
issues.fix: extend the ring arcs smoothly down into and behind the planet limb haze without a gap on the left, supersample or anti-alias the ring curves, and restore the subtle warm dispersion tint and softer highlight roll-off on the outer ring

issues.where: left and center planet horizon limb glow (also pair-04-b.png tiles A, B, I)
issues.what: the cyan atmospheric glow above the horizon is narrower and dimmer than in -a, with a subtle darker stepped band tracing the planet's geometric rim underneath the haze
issues.fix: increase the intensity and vertical falloff height of the cyan atmospheric glow along the left-to-center horizon and smooth out the dark step seam at the planet rim

issues.where: upper-left moon (tile B) and upper-right moon (tiles C, I)
issues.what: both moons appear as un-antialiased cutouts with jagged 1-px stair-stepped sunlit limbs, abrupt hard-cut terminators (with a jagged notch on the right moon), flat uniform shadow sides, and smoother sunlit shading with less crater relief than in -a
issues.fix: anti-alias both moon silhouettes by ~1 px, soften the terminator falloff into twilight, add warmer-to-cooler sunlit limb shading, and restore fine crater detail across the sunlit and twilight zones

issues.where: right equatorial dark limb at 3 o'clock
issues.what: a stray bright warm orange-white glow pokes out right against the razor-sharp dark edge of the planet where -a has only dark muted galactic dust
issues.fix: mask out or remove the stray bright warm hotspot bleeding past the right equatorial limb and soften the dark-side planet edge

issues.where: sun flare above right horizon (also pair-04-b.png tiles C, F)
issues.what: the sun is rendered as a smooth circular bloom plus soft horizontal bar, losing the crisp vertical spike and fine radial starburst needles present in -a while slightly lifting nearby sky blacks
issues.fix: add the subtle vertical spike and fine radial starburst rays to the sun flare and tighten the outer halo falloff so surrounding sky blacks match -a

issues.where: sunlit left planet limb (tiles B, D, G) and dark lower-right limb (tile E)
issues.what: the planet disc edge has slight 1-px stair-step aliasing along both the bright sunlit rim and dark lower-right limb, and a bright star sits un-occluded directly on the dark limb edge in tile E
issues.fix: anti-alias the planet disc mask by ~1 px around the full circumference and cleanly occlude background stars intersecting the dark limb

issues.where: lower-left dark cloud deck (tile D) and foreground cloud wisps
issues.what: deep shadow blacks in the lower-left foreground are slightly lifted and flatter than in -a, with slightly softer micro-contrast on the faint wispy clouds
issues.fix: deepen black levels slightly in the lower-left shadow region and restore fine micro-contrast in the foreground cloud filaments
